note: FAILED under Test Card T027 (approved cbc52d6ac, comparison figure opened afterwards). Wild-type CEN.PK2-1C reaches 0.968 of its maximum exponential growth rate at about 16 mM glucose, ten times above the trace-model value G* = 1.56 mM and wholly above the 4.7 mM failure bound. The published error bars (about 0.02 per hour) do not change this: at 2.7 mM the rate is 0.91 of the maximum. The well-mixed reading of the trace (shared glucose accumulating in the whole culture) therefore does not explain the cooperative-growth switch of yeast on sucrose; T026's not-deciding exponential rates leaned the same way. Not tested here: glucose held near the cell surface (Gore et al. 2009 diffusion analysis), which would be a new hypothesis. Strain and medium differ from Dai et al. (stated before the run). C_L3_TRACE_FEEDBACK itself (a general L1 model) is not refuted; its application to yeast as written in C_L3_TRACE_YEAST is. FAILED approved by the author in chat on 2026-11-20.
